source.name: FAO/INFOODS Food Composition Tables and Databases directory
source.note: Inclusion in the directory is not FAO endorsement. Access/format fields are as listed by FAO, not re-verified unless noted in link_checks.

method: 11 directory list pages and 220 detail pages fetched (~1 request/second; robots.txt permits these paths). One HTTP GET (first 2 KB) per listed link; status only — reachability does not prove the dataset is downloadable or reusable.
